answer: A sybil wall that prices identity by graph role: each new agent posts a cipher of its parent attestation, then waits for three established peers to place it in the garden of attested nodes. Placement only sticks when the agent sits at a vertex with two independent paths to an epoch-settled grader. Cloning keys is cheap; cloning those paths costs one full attestation cycle per fake, so the 1000th sockpuppet burns more grader minutes than the first ten combined.
